node_definition.done_when: Context: followup f-fsapi-unqualified-axis-eager-readers. The fused-route axis enforcement makes ForwardFluxOperator._support_partition (nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py) raise NoQualifiedAxisError (nova/equilibrium/topology.py:136) for an iterate, seed or perturbation with no admitted axis, where it once returned a partition. Traced callers are unaffected; eager callers can now raise. (1) Each eager benchmark or script caller is migrated, or catches the refusal explicitly and records it in its receipt or output as a named outcome, never a silent skip: benchmarks/plasma_cell_trip_panels.py, nan_tangent_localisation.py, settled_mask_stall.py, observable_route_discriminator.py, oracle_start_newton_probe.py and scripts/moment_branch_integration/measure.py. benchmarks/xpoint_cell_allocation_rca.py already catches it and shows the pattern. (2) The new tests/test_unqualified_axis_eager_routes.py asserts that the three production eager hosts in nova/equilibrium/forward.py raise NoQualifiedAxisError on an unqualified state, with a message that names the state, and that each serves a qualified state normally. The hosts are ForwardProfile.cell_current_moments and the two linear-branch reads in _integral_state. (3) In tests/test_fused_same_state_read.py, _first_unqualified_map_state currently ends in a bare AssertionError when the relaxed map stays qualified for HOST_EVALUATIONS steps. Make that exit a named failure stating the fixture never left the qualified region, so a slower fixture fails for the right reason. Gate, logged under the run directory: the new test file and tests/test_fused_same_state_read.py pass with JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu in fresh processes in place on this fleet allocation; the six benchmark and script files compile and import with __file__ printed; the negative control fails the new route tests. No change to nova/. Every uv command carries --no-sync and nothing runs uv sync. The manifest's status is one of complete, blocked or failed.
